第2824章 指导学习（第1页）
招揽的人肯定是要有真本领的才行，那些没什么真本领的人也都一个个想要进入到万宝楼之中。
三个月来，连同林铭在内，万宝楼一共招收了四个人。
这四个人也全都是有着本领存在的。
外界的这些风波，郑齐和林铭说过一些，林铭只是随意的点了点头，表示自己知道了，并没有过多的关注！
等到时候他参加升仙大会，成功加入到符箓宗，那就更是水到渠成的事情了。
四年多的时间，郑齐也已然是真心实意的将林铭当成了他的师父！
他得到了林铭的符咒炼制之法的传授。
同样的，林铭在他的身上也一样是收获了不少，只是对方根本不知道而已。
符咒之外，林铭进步最大的也就是自己的修为实力了！
如今的林铭，灵力级别依旧是炼气期不假。
可他的灵力厚度，就已然是达到了普通炼气期巅峰之人的五倍之多！
五倍多的灵力密度，让林铭同时可以操纵的灵器也已然是达到了八件！
其他人面对林铭的时候，就相当于是以一对八。
不论怎么看，林铭都占据着绝对的优势。
“师父，明天升仙大会就要正式开启了，您准备去参与么？！”
郑齐在林铭的指导下，炼制完今天的十张符咒，这才询问着。
“我来这里之前，掌柜的就已经答应过我了，允许我参加升仙大会，加入到其他宗门之中的。”

听林铭这么说，郑齐一下子就明白林铭想歪了。
“师父，你误会了，不是掌柜的让我来说的，只是我自己有些舍不得师父您，我是希望您干脆就直接变成我们万宝楼的专职制符师好了。以楼内对您的认可和掌柜的对您的重视，只要您开口，掌柜的和楼内都会同意此事的。我们万宝楼也是……”
郑齐话还没有说完，林铭已然是抬起右手，摆了摆，示意郑齐不必再说了。
“我想要加入到符箓宗，不为别的，只为筑基丹，诚如你所言，万宝楼确实并不是什么小势力了。可他会愿意为我付出筑基丹的代价么？！若是愿意的话，那我加入到万宝楼也并不是不可以商量的事情！”
听到这三个字，郑齐一下子沉默了。
这并不是郑齐第一次劝说林铭留在万宝楼内了。
他在知道了林铭的制符天赋之后，他每隔几天，就会和林铭谈一谈加入到万宝楼的事情，可林铭每次的态度都相当的统一。

Chapter 2824 Guiding Learning (Page 1)
The people recruited must have real skills. Those who have no real skills also want to enter Wanbao Tower one by one.
In the past three months, Wanbao Tower has recruited a total of four people, including Lin Ming.
These four people all have abilities.
Zheng Qi and Lin Ming talked about these disturbances in the outside world. Lin Ming just nodded casually, saying that he was aware of it and did not pay too much attention!
When the time comes for him to participate in the Immortal Ascension Conference and successfully join the Fu Lu Sect, it will be a matter of course.
For more than four years, Zheng Qi has sincerely regarded Lin Ming as his master!
He was taught the talisman refining method by Lin Ming.
Similarly, Lin Ming also gained a lot from him, but the other party didn't know it at all.
Apart from the talismans, Lin Ming's greatest improvement was his cultivation strength!
Today's Lin Ming's spiritual power level is still in the Qi refining stage.
But the thickness of his spiritual power is already five times that of a person who has reached the peak of ordinary Qi refining stage!
With more than five times the spiritual power density, Lin Ming could control eight spiritual weapons at the same time!
When other people faced Lin Ming, it was equivalent to one against eight.
No matter how you look at it, Lin Ming has an absolute advantage.
"Master, the Immortal Ascension Conference will officially start tomorrow. Are you ready to participate?!"
Zheng Qi, under Lin Ming's guidance, finished refining today's ten talismans before asking.
"Before I came here, the shopkeeper had already promised me to allow me to participate in the Immortal Ascension Conference and join other sects."
Hearing what Lin Ming said, Zheng Qi immediately understood that Lin Ming was thinking wrong.
"Master, you misunderstood. It wasn't the shopkeeper who asked me to tell you. It's just that I can't bear to leave you, Master. I hope you can simply become the full-time talisman maker of our Wanbao Building. With the recognition of you in the building and the importance the shopkeeper attaches to you, as long as you speak, the shopkeeper and the building will agree to this matter. Our Wanbao Building is also..."
Before Zheng Qi finished speaking, Lin Ming raised his right hand and waved it, indicating that Zheng Qi didn't need to say any more.
"I want to join the Fu Lu Sect, not for anything else, just for the Foundation Establishment Pill. As you said, Wanbao Tower is indeed not a small force. But will he be willing to pay the price of the Foundation Establishment Pill for me?! If he is willing, then my joining the Wanbao Tower is not a non-negotiable matter!"
Hearing these three words, Zheng Qi fell silent for a moment.
This was not the first time Zheng Qi persuaded Lin Ming to stay in Wanbao Tower.
After he learned about Lin Ming's talent for making talismans, he would talk to Lin Ming about joining Wanbao Tower every few days, but Lin Ming's attitude was quite consistent every time.
